decisions.reason: Report locates `disabled: (props.input?.phase ?? 'plain') !== 'plain' || busy`, shows busy is AttachButton's local state unbound in AttachmentChips, explains the empty early-return null path, and that a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard false so busy evaluates and throws ReferenceError, grounding each step in the fixture code.

Explains the InputZone slot entry's error boundary catches the render throw and unmounts the whole dock entry (not just the remove button), that the separate input.left attach-button slot survives, and that the diagnostic is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 file and maintainer note to establish busy already existed in baseline, flags the diff/stale-base inconsistency, proposes both a rollback/re-add bisect and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount whose stack trace attributes the throw, and independently identifies the diff's own defects (imageItem/status/record out of scope, inconsistency with baseline) rather than forcing the diff harmless.

Proposes removing the dangling busy or lifting properly owned state as an explicit prop while preserving the phase guard, hardening record?.items ?? [] and event.target?.closest?.(...), and moving the hoisted image lookup inside the map callback where record/status are defined.

Provides a concrete render/mount test with one matching occurrence in plain phase asserting the chip renders and no boundary capture, explains why empty-state-only and non-plain-phase smokes miss the expression, why node --check cannot catch runtime identifier resolution, and requires a data-present slot smoke in pre-ship checks.
